# Aaron Barlow

> HPC Software Engineer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (National Center for Computational Sciences / OLCF) building software-driven exascale HPC management platforms and agentic AI workflows.

## Experience

- **HPC Software Engineer**, Oak Ridge National Laboratory — National Center for Computational Sciences (Jun 2020 – Present, Remote)
  - Core developer of RATS (Resource Allocation and Tracking System), the system of record managing canonical state, provisioning, access controls, and scheduler policy across 27+ HPC clusters (including Frontier, the world's first exascale supercomputer) representing $700M+ in compute systems.
  - Optimized a core policy/filesystem API across 100k+ directories and 27 clusters, cutting RTT from 272s to 0.178s (~1,528x faster).
  - Delivered and expanded [myOLCF](https://my.olcf.ornl.gov), a researcher self-service portal serving 4,000+ users across 1,000+ HPC campaigns (~99.9% availability).
  - Co-architected the Smart Facility System delivering 100k time-series records in 87ms.
  - Delivered AMD ROCm-compatible NVFLARE on Frontier (MI250X GPUs + PyTorch) for privacy-preserving federated learning of medical foundation models.
- **Machine Learning Engineer Intern**, Bank of America — Consumer and Wealth Management (Jun 2019 – Aug 2019, Los Angeles, CA)
  - Built an NLP entity extraction pipeline (spaCy, Rasa, Python) for 100M+ bank documents achieving 96% F1 score and $20M+ in annual automation savings.
- **Software Developer Intern**, Oak Ridge National Laboratory — National Center for Computational Sciences (May 2015 – May 2019, Oak Ridge, TN)
  - Built operational software for 20+ HPC clusters (~$250M in compute systems), automated policy-aware access communications, and built a WordPress/REST metrics plugin for olcf.ornl.gov.

## Peer-Reviewed Publications

- **Centralizing Scheduler Policy at the OLCF: A Facility-Wide Approach to Consistent Multi-Workload Configuration** (April 26, 2026)
  - Authors: Aaron Barlow, James Davis, Alan Longcoy
  - Venue: *Proceedings of the Cray User Group (CUG 2026)*, ACM, pp. 229–237, Nice, France
  - DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3837730.3837751
  - Summary: Workload-agnostic architecture for facility-wide scheduler policy management using RATS CRM across 24 HPC and support systems at the OLCF spanning Slurm, Kubernetes, LSF, and Moab.

## Selected Projects

### Work Projects
- **American Science Cloud Hub & Portal** (2025–Present, NCCS): U.S. DOE multi-facility HPC allocation hub and self-management portal with federated authentication.
- **[myOLCF](https://my.olcf.ornl.gov)** (2020–Present, NCCS): Researcher self-service and monitoring portal with OIDC auth, allocation management, and GPU/filesystem metrics.
- **[RATS](https://doi.org/10.1145/3837730.3837751)** (2015–Present, NCCS): Canonical state and centralized scheduler policy platform across 27+ HPC clusters.
- **Structured Bank Document Extraction Pipeline** (2019–2020, Bank of America): Production NLP workflow for 100M+ digitized records (96% F1, $20M+ annual savings).

### Personal & Agentic AI Projects
- **[AI Podcast Production Pipeline](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/understand-all/id1755823546)** (2023): Automated research, scripting, ElevenLabs audio, and RSS publishing (192 episodes).
- **[Project Cadenza](https://www.youtube.com/@ProjectCadenza)** (2023–Present): Agentic music and video pipeline (150 published music videos).
- **Anthologia** (2024–Present): Multi-agent narrative video storytelling pipeline (Python, CrewAI, LangChain, ElevenLabs).
- **AI Event Prediction Trading System** (2024–Present): Real-time sentiment and event-contract trading system for Kalshi (Python, Vector DB, WebSockets).
- **Automatic E-commerce Product Creation** (2023): Automated product design, copy, pricing, and Etsy publishing (152 products).
- **HOA Management Platform** (2018–Present): Multi-community property, payments, violations, and elections platform (Ruby on Rails, React, Vite, Inertia).
